#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    if (!std::getline(std::cin, input)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to read input");
    }
    
    int total = 0;
    int pos = 0;
    int len = input.length();
    
    while (pos < len) {
        int next = pos;
        char c = input[pos];
        while (next < len && input[next] == c) {
            next++;
        }
        total += (next - pos + 1) % 2;
        pos = next;
    }
    
    std::cout << total << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
